item.title: Noto Kiriko Festival: A Summer Tradition of Illuminated Lantern Floats — Guide
item.description: Kiriko festivals take place throughout the summer months across dozens of towns and villages on the Noto Peninsula, each community holding its own version of the tradition on a different date, carrying towering illuminated lantern floats called kiriko through the streets, often accompanied by drumming, chanting and a genuinely communal, participatory atmosphere. Unlike a single centralised event, the kiriko tradition is spread across the entire peninsula through the summer, giving visitors the chance to catch a smaller, more local festival experience beyond the larger, better-known Wajima Grand Festival.
